# Victory Foam

## About
Victory Foam is a foam and mattress manufacturer based in Coventry, United
Kingdom. We produce specified foam products for bedding, furniture,
industrial, packaging, acoustic, and healthcare applications.

This website is a static company brochure and display-only product catalog.
It does not publish prices, accept orders, or provide a shopping cart.

## Main Sections
- Products: /products/
- About: /about/
- Gallery: /gallery/
- Contact: /contact/

## Product Categories
- Mattresses
- Toppers & Pillows
- Industrial Foam
- Custom Cut Foam

Product details are available at /products/{product-slug}/. For specifications,
availability, or manufacturing enquiries, use /contact/.
